metadata.title: GIFT CONNECT Parenting Suite — Murray Partners 4 Prevention
metadata.description: Free AI-powered parenting support for Murray families. Voice assistant, personalized lullabies, custom storybooks, and 24/7 guidance in 80+ languages.

features.title: Sammie Voice & Text Assistant
features.description: 24/7 answers to any parenting question, in 80+ languages.

features.title: Geno Song Generator
features.description: Personalized lullabies using your child's name.

features.title: Stacey Storybook Creator
features.description: Custom illustrated stories featuring your child.

features.title: Milestone Tracker
features.description: Log developmental milestones and spot delays early.

features.title: Local Resource Finder
features.description: Quick links to SNAP, WIC, food banks, childcare help, and clinics in Salt Lake County.

features.title: Parenting Journal
features.description: A private space to capture the moments you don't want to forget.

features.title: Daily Tips
features.description: Short, science-backed parenting tips delivered each day.

features.title: Screen-Free Weekends
features.description: Location- and weather-aware activity ideas that get the whole family off devices and together.

features.title: SMS Access
features.description: Text-based access to Sammie for families without a smartphone.

features.title: Cohort Portal
features.description: For families in Legacy of Literacy Circles and other group programs.
